products.name: Intel Xeon 6980P Processor
products.summary: 128-core Xeon 6 P-core flagship with 504 MB cache and 12-channel DDR5/MRDIMM-8800.
products.description: The Xeon 6980P (Xeon 6 with P-cores (Granite Rapids)) has 128 cores and 256 threads, a 2.0 GHz base and up to 3.9 GHz turbo, 504 MB of cache and a 500 W TDP. It uses socket FCLGA7529 with 12 memory channels (DDR5-6400, MRDIMM-8800) and scales to two sockets.
products.keywords: intel xeon 6980p xeon 6 server cpu fclga7529

products.name: Intel Xeon 6972P Processor
products.summary: 96-core Xeon 6 P-core processor with a 2.4 GHz base and 480 MB cache.
products.description: The Xeon 6972P (Xeon 6 with P-cores (Granite Rapids)) has 96 cores and 192 threads, a 2.4 GHz base and up to 3.9 GHz turbo, 480 MB of cache and a 500 W TDP. It uses socket FCLGA7529 with 12 memory channels (DDR5-6400, MRDIMM-8800) and scales to two sockets.
products.keywords: intel xeon 6972p xeon 6 server cpu fclga7529

products.name: Intel Xeon 6787P Processor
products.summary: 86-core Xeon 6 P-core processor for mainstream 8-channel FCLGA4710 servers.
products.description: The Xeon 6787P (Xeon 6 with P-cores (Granite Rapids)) has 86 cores and 172 threads, a 2.0 GHz base and up to 3.8 GHz turbo, 336 MB of cache and a 350 W TDP. It uses socket FCLGA4710 with 8 memory channels (DDR5-6400, MRDIMM-8800) and scales to two sockets.
products.keywords: intel xeon 6787p xeon 6 server cpu fclga4710

products.name: Intel Xeon 6990E+ Processor
products.summary: 288 E-core Xeon 6+ (Clearwater Forest, Intel 18A) for dense, efficient cloud-native and hyperscale workloads.
products.description: The Xeon 6990E+ (Xeon 6+ with E-cores, formerly Clearwater Forest, Intel 18A) has 288 cores and 288 threads, a 2.2 GHz base and up to 3.2 GHz turbo, 576 MB of cache and a 450 W TDP. It uses socket FCLGA7529 with 12 memory channels (DDR5-8000 RDIMM) and scales to two sockets.
products.keywords: intel xeon 6990e+ xeon 6 server cpu fclga7529

products.name: Intel Arc B580 Graphics 12 GB
products.summary: Xe2 'Battlemage' desktop GPU with 20 Xe-cores, 12 GB GDDR6 and 233 peak INT8 TOPS.
products.description: Intel Arc B580 uses the Xe2 (Battlemage) architecture with 20 Xe-cores and 20 ray-tracing units at a 2,670 MHz graphics clock. It has 12 GB of GDDR6 on a 192-bit bus (456 GB/s), a PCIe 4.0 x8 interface and a 190 W total board power, and Intel rates it at 233 peak INT8 TOPS.
products.keywords: intel arc b580 battlemage xe2 12gb budget 1440p gpu

products.name: Intel Arc Pro B70 32 GB
products.summary: 32 Xe-core professional GPU with 32 GB GDDR6 and 367 INT8 TOPS for AI inference and pro visualization.
products.description: Arc Pro B70 is Intel's highest-end Arc Pro B-Series card: 32 Xe-cores and 32 ray-tracing units at 2,280 MHz, 32 GB of GDDR6 on a 256-bit interface (608 GB/s) and PCIe 5.0 x16. Intel rates it at 367 peak INT8 TOPS with a 230 W total board power, in a 2-slot, 10.5 in card. It launched March 25, 2026 as an Intel-branded card and via AIB partners.
products.keywords: intel arc pro b70 32gb battlemage workstation ai inference gpu

products.name: Intel Arc Pro B60 24 GB
products.summary: 20 Xe-core professional GPU with 24 GB GDDR6 for multi-GPU LLM inference and workstation apps.
products.description: Arc Pro B60 has 20 Xe-cores and 20 ray-tracing units at 2,400 MHz, 24 GB of GDDR6 on a 192-bit interface (456 GB/s) and a PCIe 5.0 x8 interface. Intel rates it at 197 peak INT8 TOPS with a 200 W total board power; it is sold through Intel AIB partners in several form factors.
products.keywords: intel arc pro b60 24gb battlemage workstation llm inference

products.name: Intel Arc Pro B50 16 GB
products.summary: Compact 70 W, 16 GB professional GPU with 16 Xe-cores in a small-form-factor dual-slot card.
products.description: Arc Pro B50 has 16 Xe-cores and 16 ray-tracing units at 1,700 MHz, 16 GB of GDDR6 on a 128-bit bus (224 GB/s) and a PCIe 5.0 x8 interface. It draws 70 W total board power, is rated at 170 peak INT8 TOPS and measures 6.6 in x 2.7 in in a dual-slot form factor.
products.keywords: intel arc pro b50 16gb small form factor 70w workstation gpu
